g.text: Spatial20 Policy Tree · identical recorded observations
Every root/region cell-side maximum is 20 m for every method; other hard bounds remain.
Connected points are measured schedules, not a fitted regression or a prediction between grid sizes.
Adaptive references retain their own variable cell sizes/windows (up to 4 s). Missing conditional metrics are n/a.
Distortion assigns cost 1 to omitted contributions. Policy compliance and utility do not establish measured privacy gain.
